transcriptionMethod: Visual transcription of the Grounded Reasoning Trace and Grounded Answer panels in the supplied demo recording.
timestampNote: Timestamps inside the trace refer to the original scene, not the replay position in the demo recording or the cropped webpage sample.
provenanceNote: This is a transcription of visible recorded UI text, not a recovered raw inference file and not a new inference run.
formattingNote: Visual line wrapping is normalized into one paragraph. A <think> wrapper is added for display; it is not visible around the recorded trace. The existing <answer> wrapper is preserved from the recorded answer.
